plugins.name: deslop
plugins.description: Rewrites or drafts text so it reads as a specific human making specific choices, instead of generic AI output — preserves the writer's actual intent, stance, certainty, and voice rather than adding stereotypical "human" quirks, typos, or randomness meant to evade AI detectors. Runs a bundled mechanical analyzer (cliché/filler frames, forced closure, transition overuse, sentence-length monotony, paragraph-opener repetition, a passive-voice heuristic, generic-AI vocabulary) that reports candidates for judgment, never a verdict, plus a gated learning loop that mines multi-word frames from accepted edits into a review queue.
